comment: VP-6 combat overlays (D-800): the pile ids of the pile viewer, the flask art key and prefix, the keyword and rating string-key templates the readings use, and one word separator. Names of UXML regions, classes and resources are in ui.json (UiNames, UiClasses, UiResources).

keySets.name: OverlayKeys
keySets.doc: Keys of the content the overlays read that the combat keys do not name.

keySets.name: OverlayValues
keySets.doc: Values of the combat overlays: the pile ids, the flask art key prefix (catalog/flasks.json artKey 'flask-crimson' -> art 'flask.crimson'), the rating ids of a combatant reading, the tag prefix of a card trait and the separator of two words.

keySets.name: OverlayFormats
keySets.doc: String-key templates of the overlays (strings/en.json keyword and resource names).
